stem: Which of these is the most likely result of the process shown in the diagram?

options.label: F
options.text: Chromosome replication will cease to avoid errors that result in mutations.

options.label: G
options.text: Offspring will no longer express traits from previous generations.

options.label: H
options.text: Gametes will contain new allele combinations.

options.label: J
options.text: Chromatids will have less genetic variety.

visual_elements: Diagram showing chromosomes undergoing a process.
